title: Vec<(&str, &str)> in download_blob could avoid explicit type annotation
description: blob.rs line 170: 'let vars: Vec<(&str, &str)> = vec\![...]'. The explicit type annotation is unnecessary; Rust infers the element type from the literals. Clippy may flag this with clippy::redundant_type_annotations. Idiomatic: 'let vars = vec\![...]'. Minor readability improvement; no functional impact.
